goal:
I'm writing about the Penn Museum's 2022 reopening and want to cite its "Building Transformation" page: https://www.penn.museum/transformation/
More than how many square feet of reimagined galleries and visitor spaces could visitors experience on the opening weekend? Please tell me where you found it.

paragraphs: Meet us at the Sphinx on November 16 and 17 for the new Penn Museum’s Opening Celebration Weekend . Experience more than 10,000 square feet of reimagined galleries and new visitor spaces, plus entertainment and activities for the whole family.
We’ll see you at the Sphinx!
